'''Catherby''' is a small [[fishing]] town located south-east of [[Camelot]] and west of [[White Wolf Mountain]]. It is a [[Members|members-only]] town with vast variety of [[fishing spots]] available on its shores for all levels of Fishing. It is also a popular town for [[Woodcutting|woodcutters]] due to the vast amount of trees to the west of the town.

To the east of Catherby is White Wolf Mountain. This area can be deadly to low-level players as level 25 and 38 [[aggressive]] [[White wolf|white wolves]] inhabit this area. To the west of Catherby is Camelot and [[Seers' Village]], and to the south-west is the mighty city of [[East Ardougne]], the capital of [[Kandarin]].

==Transportation==
*Walk across White Wolf Mountain from [[Taverley]].
** Take a [[gnome glider]] to the top of [[White Wolf Mountain]] and walk south.
**Take the [[White Wolf Tunnel|Dwarven Pass]] under the mountain from Taverley (requires completion of [[Fishing Contest]]).
*[[Camelot Teleport]], then run south-east.
*[[Catherby Teleport]] from the [[Lunar spellbook]].
*[[Kandarin headgear 3]]/[[Kandarin headgear_4|4]] teleport to [[Sherlock]] and run north-east.
*Take a [[charter ship]] to Catherby docks.
*[[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|BLR}} - to the [[Legends' Guild]], then follow the coastline north-east.
*[[Mooring point|Docking]] at the port with level 20 [[Sailing]].

==Features==
*A [[Catherby bank|bank]].
*[[Fishing spot]]s for [[Small fishing net|small net]], [[Big fishing net|big net]], [[harpoon]], and [[lobster pot]] fishing.
*A [[Farming]] [[allotment]] and [[Farming/Patch locations#Fruit tree patches|fruit tree patch]].
*An [[Agility]] [[Mith grapple|grapple]] [[shortcut]] to [[Taverley]] that provides a quick link between both of the towns.
*An Agility grapple shortcut from the [[Taverley Dungeon]] to Catherby.
*Transportation to other docks or purchasing exotic items via the [[Charter ships|charter ship]].
*A [[range]] for [[Cooking]], conveniently located on the way to the bank from the Fishing spots.
*Two [[water]] sources.
*[[Yew tree]]s and [[willow tree]]s for [[Woodcutting]].
*[[Docking point]] for [[Sailing]], including a [[notice board]] and [[salvaging station]]

*[[Hickton's Archery Emporium]]: [[Hickton]], the shop owner, sells the [[Fletching cape]] for 99,000 [[coins]].

==Farming patches==
To the north of Catherby lies a large Farming patch, containing two [[allotment]]s, one [[herb patch]], and one [[Farming/Patch locations#Allotment/Flower/Herb patches|flower patch]]. Standing nearby is, as usual, a handy [[tool leprechaun]]. Players can pay [[Dantaera]], the nearby [[Group of Advanced Gardeners|gardener]], to watch over their crops for them or for Farming supplies.

Players who have completed the medium, hard, or elite levels of the [[Kandarin Diary]] will get a 5%, 10%, or 15% increase, respectively, to their Catherby herb patch yield. This stacks with the [[magic secateurs]]/[[Farming cape]]. Wearing the [[Kandarin headgear]] while harvesting is not required to gain the increased yield.

There is also a [[Farming/Patch locations#Fruit tree patches|fruit tree patch]] located on the south-eastern beach near [[White Wolf Mountain]], for growing [[fruit tree]]s. Players can pay [[Ellena]] to watch over their fruit tree for them.

==Fishing==
[[File:Catherby beach.png|thumb|The famous sunny beaches of Catherby.]]
This place has a great variety of fish for players with 68 [[Fishing]] or lower. There are [[fishing spots]] where players can use [[Small fishing net|small nets]], [[fishing rod]]s, [[Big fishing net|big nets]], [[harpoon]]s, and [[lobster pot]]s. This allows players to catch:

*Small net: [[Raw shrimps|shrimp]], [[raw anchovies|anchovies]]
*Fishing rod (bait): [[Raw sardine|sardine]], [[raw herring|herring]]
*Big net: [[raw mackerel|mackerel]], [[raw cod|cod]], [[raw bass|bass]]
*Harpoon: [[Raw tuna|tuna]], [[raw swordfish|swordfish]], [[raw shark|shark]]
*Lobster pot: [[Raw lobster|lobster]]

==Sailing info==
Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at Catherby with level 20 [[Sailing]]. The dock south of the town offers the following utilities for sailors:
*[[File:Shipwright map icon.png|link=Shipwright]] [[Shipwright]]
*[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]]
*[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]]
*[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]]
*[[File:Bank icon.png|link=Bank deposit box]] [[Bank deposit box]]

==Houses==
In the small two-story house directly south of the [[Farming#Farming patches|farming patch]] is an [[insect repellent]] [[Spawning|spawn]]. This is used during the [[Merlin's Crystal]] and [[Troll Romance]] quests. Upstairs in this house is a [[jug of wine]] spawn.

To the east of this house is another house that belongs to a man named [[Caleb]]. He is met during the [[Family Crest]] quest. Inside his house is a [[range]] and [[sink]]. There are also [[pie dish]], [[Burnt food|burnt fish]], [[jug of water]], [[knife]], and [[bucket of water]] spawns in his house too.

To the east of Caleb's house is another house, containing three strange chests that are locked up in a cage.

There is a house to the east of the bank with a range. This range is often used as it is very close to the [[Catherby bank|bank]].

==Government==
Catherby is part of the [[Kingdom of Kandarin]].  The local government of Catherby is run by the [[Mayor of Catherby]] and the Catherby Council, one member of which is [[Councillor Catherine]].  The Mayor of Catherby has been, for a long time, a fish.

==Charter ship==
The [[charter ship]]s also have a dock in the harbour at the south of Catherby. It provides rides to several other locations. After completing [[Cabin Fever]], the charter ship fare is reduced by 50%. Wearing the [[ring of charos(a)|ring of Charos(a)]] also reduces the fare by 50%. These two bonuses can be stacked to reduce the cost to 25%.

{{Charter ship fares}}
